How key storage works

By default, keys are removed when Edge exits or the extension is reloaded or disabled. Remembered keys are stored locally without encryption by the extension, until you forget or replace them. Save a replacement with this box unchecked to return to session-only storage.

Reading key status…

Saving a key updates key storage immediately. Use Save settings to apply your provider and model selection.

05

Schedule a session

Open an event when it starts, then close its tab when time is up.

Ready when Edge is running

Keep Edge running and your computer awake. A scheduled session uses your saved connection, provider, and request limit at its start, and enables background mode for that session. Unsaved settings above are not used.

Use the HTTPS participant link. You may still need to sign in or enter your name in the event tab.

Between 1 minute and 8 hours.

Times use this browser's local time zone.

Suggestions wait for your approval in the extension. Choose automatic submission to answer while you are away.

Timing, background access, and API keys

Edge may deliver a scheduled start late. If the event's time window is still open, the session can start and will end at the original deadline. Expired sessions are skipped. Only the tab created for the scheduled session is closed. If you navigate that tab away from its event, it is left open.

Schedules cannot overlap. A scheduled session will not interrupt another session already running when its start time arrives.

Background mode uses Edge's debugger connection and may show a debugging banner. Keep DevTools closed for the event tab. Session-only API keys are lost when Edge exits; add your key again before the start, or choose to remember it with your permission.

Schedules are stored on this device, independently of Save settings. Check that your connection works before scheduling a real event.
